angkor.evidence:
Calm-water paddling: 53 lake(s) of 1 km2 or more (OpenStreetMap natural=water, lake or reservoir), for example បឹង​ទន្លេសាប (2431 km2), អាងស្តុកទឹកសេសានក្រោម២ (224 km2) plus 2 canoe or kayak rental points or clubs (OpenStreetMap, merged within 300 m) = 55, which gives 10 (0 is 0, 1 is 2, 2-3 is 3, 4-6 is 4, 7-10 is 6, 11-20 is 8, 21 or more is 10).
Sea kayaking: 285 km of coastline inside the area (Natural Earth 10 m coast, which smooths bays and fjords, so long coasts are underestimated) gives 8; 0 kayak or canoe rental points within 3 km of the coast gives 0; average 4. No wave record was available at the coast points tried, so no wave reduction is applied.
Whitewater and multi-day: not researched, left blank.
Water temperature: warm (mean air temperature 26.0 C in the paddling months (Nov, Dec, Jan), Open-Meteo archive 2019-2024, as an upper bound for the water (no sea temperature record was available at the coast points tried, so the coast uses air temperature too)).
Skill levels: never (derived: never-paddled where calm-water paddling is 3 or more or class I-II is run; a little where class I-II or III is run; experienced where class IV or V is run).
